issuers.title: Companies (tickers or CIKs)
issuers.description: Ticker symbols (AAPL, NVDA) or raw SEC CIK numbers (320193). Tickers are resolved against SEC's own official ticker->CIK map, so a ticker that SEC does not list is skipped with a warning rather than silently returning nothing.

formTypes.title: Ownership form types
formTypes.description: Form 4 is the one that matters for trade signals (a transaction reported within 2 business days). Form 3 is an initial statement of holdings and Form 5 is an annual catch-up; both are mostly holdings rather than open-market trades, so a Form 3 filing often yields zero transaction rows.

sinceDate.title: Only filings on/after this date
sinceDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for no lower bound. SEC's filing index is newest-first, so this stops paging as soon as it passes the date.

maxFilingsPerIssuer.title: Max filings per company
maxFilingsPerIssuer.description: How many matching ownership filings to open per company. One filing usually yields 1-4 transaction rows.

includeDerivative.title: Include derivative transactions
includeDerivative.description: Derivative rows are options, RSUs and convertible securities (with exercise price, expiration and underlying share count). Turn off to get only the non-derivative common-stock rows.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on transaction rows returned (and therefore on what you are charged).
